$comment: Read by tools/ci/check-audit.mjs. watch: advisories reported as "watched" (never a waiver; a re-rating to High/Critical fails the gate): { id, package, reason, review_by: YYYY-MM-DD, source }. waivers: the only way to pass a High/Critical finding (US-048 Waiver scenario, AT-US-048-07), and the tracking record with a due date for one without an upstream fix: { id, package, reason, decision: DECISIONS.md ID, expires: YYYY-MM-DD }; an expired waiver fails the finding again. A package in maintenance-exceptions.json cannot be waived. New entries need security-analyst review (CODEOWNERS).

watch.reason: Dev-only (ESLint, Jest, test-exclude); needs an attacker-supplied glob pattern, ours come from committed config only. Bump when the tools depend on minimatch >= 11.0.1; no overrides (major jump inside gate tooling).
Dev-only (Jest, test-exclude, archiver walk our own repository); no AbortSignal-bounded walk over untrusted input. Bump when the tools depend on glob >= 14.0.2.
Dev-only (jest-config merges our own Jest config); no upstream fix.
